spec.title: Authoritative DNS Availability
spec.description: Successful direct root NS probes over the selected dashboard time range.

spec.title: Authoritative DNS Probe Duration
spec.description: End-to-end duration of direct root NS probes, split by resolver, transport, and root server.

spec.title: Authoritative DNS Probe Status
spec.description: Direct non-recursive root NS probes from each resolver. A UDP-only failure indicates a transport-specific path problem.

spec.title: CoreDNS Cache Hit Rate
spec.description: CoreDNS cache hit percentage, grouped by cluster.

spec.title: CoreDNS QPS
spec.description: CoreDNS requests per second, grouped by cluster.

spec.title: CoreDNS Request Latency p99
spec.description: 99th percentile CoreDNS request duration, grouped by cluster.

spec.title: CoreDNS SERVFAIL Rate
spec.description: SERVFAIL responses per second from in-cluster CoreDNS, grouped by cluster.

spec.title: DNSSEC Bogus and Validation Logs
spec.description: Knot Resolver journald entries shipped by Vector from resolver1 and resolver2.

spec.title: external-dns Error Rate
spec.description: Registry (provider) and source errors per second, grouped by cluster.

spec.title: external-dns Last Sync Age
spec.description: Time since the last successful full sync to the DNS provider, worst cluster.

spec.title: external-dns Records
spec.description: Records desired by sources vs records present in the registry, grouped by cluster. The two lines should sit on top of each other; a persistent gap means records are failing to sync. Zone apex records (NS, SOA) are excluded because no source can produce them.

spec.title: external-dns Registry Errors (1h)
spec.description: Errors talking to the DNS provider (registry) in the last hour, all clusters.

spec.title: external-dns Source Errors (1h)
spec.description: Errors reading route sources (HTTPRoute/Service/...) in the last hour, all clusters.

spec.title: external-dns Sync Age
spec.description: Seconds since the last provider sync and source reconcile, worst pod per cluster. A steadily climbing line means external-dns has stopped syncing.

spec.title: Failed Authoritative DNS Probes
spec.description: Current failed direct root NS probes across both resolvers and transports.

spec.title: pdns-auth QPS
spec.description: Authoritative queries per second across both transports.

spec.title: Resolver Cache Usage
spec.description: LMDB pages allocated against the configured map size. When the map fills, every stash fails and the cache is dropped, which collapses the hit rate and floods upstream with recursion until it refills -- see the 2026-08-10 addendum to ADR-0030. kresd publishes no cache metric, so this is read from the database's meta page by the textfile collector; data.mdb's own size is preallocated to the map size and cannot be used.

spec.title: Resolver Manager Memory
spec.description: Resident memory of the knot-resolver manager process only. The kresd workers that hold the cache and answer queries are not included -- the exporter attaches no instance_id to process_* series, so there is one reading per host regardless of worker count. Cache occupancy is in the panel beside this one.

spec.title: Resolver Metrics Age
spec.description: Worst age of the node_exporter textfile, which the collector rewrites every 15s. Healthy readings run up to about 46s because the age carries the Prometheus scrape interval on top of the write interval; red matches the KnotResolverMetricsStale alert.

spec.title: Resolver Metrics Freshness
spec.description: Per-resolver textfile age, which carries up to one scrape interval on top of the real age: the collector rewrites every 15s, Prometheus scrapes every 30s, and the reading climbs between scrapes. Healthy values sweep roughly 11-45s. Zoomed in the shape is a rising sawtooth; at the default range the step equals the scrape interval and the same signal aliases into a slow drift with occasional jumps. Neither shape is a fault -- only a line that climbs past 60s and keeps going, which means the collector stopped.
